# Psalm 87 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-the-sons-of Korah. A-psalm. A-song. His-foundation on-mountains-of holiness.

**2** Loves YHWH the-gates-of Zion more-than-all the-dwellings-of Jacob.

**3** Glorious-things are-spoken of-you, O-city-of God. Selah.

**4** I-will-mention Rahab and-Babylon to-those-knowing-me; behold Philistia and-Tyre with Cush — 'This-one was-born there.'

**5** And-to-Zion it-will-be-said, 'Man and-man was-born in-her,' and-he the-Most-High will-establish-her.

**6** YHWH will-record in-writing-of the-peoples, 'This-one was-born there.' Selah.

**7** And-singers as-dancers: 'All my-springs are-in-you.'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **87:4**: Rahab (rahav) = Egypt (mythological sea-monster name applied to Egypt); five nations listed as Zion's adopted 'citizens.'

- **87:5**: 'Man and-man was-born in-her' — repeated emphasis: multiple peoples will claim Zion as birthplace.

— EMET
